cues.zhText: 从暗红的单纯性、灰黄的化脓性，再到焦黑的坏疽性，这是急性阑尾炎最常见的经典演变路径——但请记住，它并不是每个患者都必须走完的固定流程。
highlightZh: 并不是每个患者都必须走完的固定流程
cues.enText: From dark-red simple, to grayish-yellow phlegmonous, to black gangrenous—this is the classic pathway, yet not a rigid sequence every patient must go through.

cues.zhText: 如果战火还停留在早期的单纯性阶段，中性粒细胞主要聚集在黏膜和黏膜下层，更深处的平滑肌层里，只能零星见到散在的寥寥几个。
cues.enText: In early simple appendicitis, neutrophils gather mostly in the mucosa and submucosa, with only a few scattered in the smooth muscle layer.

cues.zhText: 可一旦化脓蔓延全层，肿胀压迫血管、甚至让阑尾系膜静脉里长出血栓，血液供应就会被彻底掐断——
cues.enText: Once suppuration floods every layer, swelling and mesenteric venous thrombosis can cut off blood supply completely—

cues.zhText: 失去血供的阑尾迅速发黑坏死，变成最凶险的坏疽性阑尾炎；脆弱的管壁随时可能穿孔，脓液涌入腹腔，引爆危及生命的弥漫性腹膜炎。
cues.enText: Starved of blood, the appendix turns black and necrotic as gangrenous appendicitis; its fragile wall can perforate, triggering life-threatening peritonitis.
